notes.title: Patch 0.1.2.i
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed Localization Bug (still needs to be tested since I can't recreate it. Please report any errors)
[*] Overall performance increase
[*] Added 2 new Abilities
[*] Changed Health Regen formula
[*] Added new Stat: Life Steal
[*] Added Mouse Over Descriptions for Stats
[*] Jotunheim: Fixed spawn issue after killing boss in under 2 minutes
[*] Muspelheim: Fixed fire wall dealing no damage to the player
[*] Fixed Boss Chest spawning outside of world boundaries
[*] Warpaint: Deactivated 'Power Surge' for now until we fix the issue
[/list]
